source_selection.selection_rule: Choose the ascending Unicode scalar/code-point lexicographic minimum of the exact frozen official run IDs; because all IDs are ASCII this is also unsigned ASCII byte lexicographic order. Do not normalize, case-fold, parse numeric suffixes, or use list order.
source_selection.source_failure_scope: Official transport or HTTP failure, incomplete response, exact-byte mismatch, official-MD5 mismatch, unreadable ZIP, or inability to resolve the single published floor3_1 source-native calibration/pose/RGB/depth roles under the frozen implementation.
source_selection.invalid_exception_scope: Forbidden preclaim or payload access, unsafe/encrypted/drive-relative member, normalized duplicate, multiple candidate roots, post-download control/index inconsistency, binding drift, implementation failure after claim, or independent-validation mismatch.

Freeze an implementation lock containing exact paths and SHA-256 for a minimal bootstrap, acquisition, source-role resolver, geometry producer, independent validator, and tests.

Using the frozen bootstrap, verify only the named control documents and implementation files, then exclusively create and fsync exactly one claim binding all document and implementation hashes; before that claim, do not resolve, stat, list, open, create, or request the candidate payload path or URL.
Only after exclusive claim creation succeeds may the canonical URL or any floor3_1 payload path be requested, resolved, statted, listed, opened, or created.
Perform exactly one complete GET to the canonical URL with no redirect, HEAD, range, retry, resume, fallback, mirror, repack, alternate archive, floor3_2, floor3_3, CoRBS, or KITTI-360.
While writing once, compute official MD5, local SHA-256, and exact byte count; require bytes=2211008069 and MD5=585d38855ad7d04817991cdbbb72016b before opening the ZIP.
Freeze the exact normalized ZIP member name/size/CRC inventory and source-role resolution before geometry evaluation.

archive_identity_contract.official_identity_gate: The complete response must simultaneously match file ID c595882daafe788a29d687872cc1fc2a, 2211008069 bytes, and MD5 585d38855ad7d04817991cdbbb72016b.
archive_identity_contract.local_evidence_hash: Record SHA-256 of the same complete response body without substituting it for the official MD5 gate.
archive_identity_contract.role_resolution_rule: The preclaim implementation lock must freeze an exact allowlist and deterministic resolver derived only from published CID-SIMS metadata/documentation. Zero or multiple matches for a required role is source HOLD; the resolver may not be revised after claim.
archive_identity_contract.member_freeze: Before geometry, freeze exact normalized member names, uncompressed sizes, CRC32 values, member count, and semantic-role mapping.
archive_identity_contract.unsafe_member_policy: Any absolute path, drive prefix, parent traversal, duplicate normalized path, encrypted member, or multiple candidate roots yields INVALID_R2_EVIDENCE / INVALID.

geometry_rule.window_partition: Use exactly the first complete half-open 10.000 s window beginning at the first timestamp jointly covered by aligned RGB-D indices and bracketing source-native camera-to-world pose. Do not evaluate a second window, slide, rank, recenter, trim, reverse, or replace the window.
geometry_rule.pair_rule: Use consecutive source-native associated RGB-D rows with 0 < dt <= 0.100 s. Both timestamps require bracketing poses no wider than 0.100 s and the previous row's indexed depth member. Missing or invalid pose/depth abstains; the candidate-pair denominator is never reduced.
geometry_rule.point_rule: Decode only the previous aligned depth payload; divide depth values by 1000 for meters; sample a deterministic 8 px raster; require positive finite depth, published D455 pinhole projection, radius >= 8 px from principal point, in-bounds rotation-only and full-pose projections, and nearest-depth retention for duplicate projected pixels.
geometry_rule.window_summaries: Median of each pair summary over evaluable pairs.
geometry_rule.admission_rule: Admission succeeds iff the single frozen window satisfies every gate. Otherwise R2 is HOLD. There is no alternate source, second window, best-window rescue, threshold revision, denominator revision, pose-direction flip, or RGB inspection.
geometry_rule.threshold_provenance: Unchanged from R0/R1: 0.05 s^-1 preserves the static-approach gate and PB-H1 physical calibration; 0.75 requires signed radial coherence beyond lateral 50/50 behavior; 0.80 preserves the paired-denominator guardrail.

identity_ancestry_reuse_and_confirmation.content_identity: Official file ID plus exact bytes plus official MD5 plus local complete-body SHA-256 plus floor3_1 plus exact half-open timestamp bounds.
identity_ancestry_reuse_and_confirmation.future_confirmation_policy: Any R2 floor3_1 payload byte or geometry access permanently excludes floor3_1, floor3_2, floor3_3, the shared Floor3 pointcloud, every archive variant, and all derivatives from confirmation for this claim.

performance_qualification_gate.hold_or_invalid_effect: RGB algorithm execution and performance qualification remain nonexistent and closed.
performance_qualification_gate.success_effect: A separate new task may be created; R2 itself still does not implement or run RGB algorithm or performance qualification.
